There are lots of young people now intending to qualify both at the bar and as solicitors, who have been through university, have done excellently and are not able to get a training contract or pupillage. This is, actually, a disgraceful situation. It's not unique to Wales; it's throughout England and Wales. But it's a matter we must address, and it's something that I engaged in various discussions about during that conference last week and I'm hoping that we might be able to take it forward at a quickened pace with the necessary finances in place.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Wel, rhywfaint o gynnydd; fe roddais i'r araith. Ond mae hwn yn fater pwysig, rydym ni'n edrych arno ond, wrth gwrs, yr hyn sy'n waelodol, yn y diwedd, yw cyllid. Nid oes diffyg ewyllys i wneud yr hyn sy'n angenrheidiol. Mae yna lawer o bobl ifanc yn bwriadu cymhwyso wrth y bar ac yn gyfreithwyr erbyn hyn, sydd wedi bod trwy'r brifysgol, wedi gwneud yn ardderchog ac nad ydyn nhw'n gallu cael cytundebau hyfforddi neu i fod yn ddisgyblion. Mae hon yn sefyllfa warthus, mewn gwirionedd. Nid yw'n unigryw i Gymru; mae hyn y digwydd ledled Cymru a Lloegr. Ond mae'n fater y mae'n rhaid i ni fynd i'r afael ag ef, ac mae'n rhywbeth y gwnes i gymryd rhan mewn trafodaethau amrywiol amdano yn ystod y gynhadledd honno'r wythnos diwethaf ac rwy'n gobeithio y gallwn ni fwrw ymlaen ar fwy o gyflymder gyda'r cyllid angenrheidiol yn ei le.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim:
Thank you for that answer. I'm sure we'll return to that next month. What I'll also say, of course, on that, is that you've got approximately £200 million underspent, sitting there available, so you could be looking to use some of that.

But I want to move on to the tribunal system. I know you said it is also high in your priorities, Counsel General. The proposed new Welsh tribunal structure is intended not only to bring existing devolved tribunals into a more coherent system, but also be capable of taking on additional jurisdiction in the future. Before any additional jurisdiction is transferred into the Welsh tribunal system, what safeguards do you believe need to be in place?
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated:
Diolch i chi am yr ateb yna. Rwy'n siŵr y byddwn ni'n dychwelyd at hynny fis nesaf. Yr hyn y byddaf i'n ei ddweud hefyd, wrth gwrs, ynglŷn â hynny, yw bod gennych chi oddeutu £200 miliwn heb ei wario, sy'n aros yno ar gael, felly fe allech chi fod yn ystyried defnyddio rhywfaint o hwnnw.

Ond fe hoffwn i symud ymlaen at system y tribiwnlysoedd. Fe wn i chi ddweud bod hynny hefyd yn un o'ch blaenoriaethau pwysicaf chi, Gwnsler Cyffredinol. Bwriad y strwythur newydd arfaethedig ar gyfer tribiwnlysoedd Cymru yw nid yn unig i ddwyn y tribiwnlysoedd datganoledig presennol i system sy'n fwy cydlynol, ond hefyd ar gyfer gallu ymgymryd ag awdurdodaeth ychwanegol yn y dyfodol. Cyn i unrhyw awdurdodaeth ychwanegol gael ei throsglwyddo i system tribiwnlysoedd Cymru, pa fesurau diogelu a ydych chi'n credu y bydd angen eu rhoi ar waith?

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: That's looking far ahead, actually, but it has been left open for possible future development. My brief is to look at the six current tiers of Welsh tribunals and the appellate tier above them. That is what I'm concentrating on now. Clearly, the Member is right—in the future, at some point, there may be others that might be devolved, and we'd have to consider the safeguards when they are up for discussion. But it's nowhere near on the horizon at this moment in time, nor is it hidden from sight either. It's simply not on the agenda at the moment, and I say that with respect to the gentleman.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Edrych ymhell ymlaen yw hynna, mewn gwirionedd, ond fe gafodd ei adael yn agored ar gyfer datblygiad posibl yn y dyfodol. Fy mriff i yw edrych ar y chwe haen bresennol o dribiwnlysoedd Cymru a'r haen apêl sydd uwch eu pennau nhw. Dyna'r hyn yr wyf i'n canolbwyntio arno nawr. Yn amlwg, mae'r Aelod yn gywir—yn y dyfodol, ar ryw adeg, efallai y bydd eraill a allai gael eu datganoli, ac fe fyddai'n rhaid i ni ystyried y mesurau diogelu wrth i'r rhain gael eu trafod. Ond nid yw hynny'n agos o gwbl ar hyn o bryd, ac ni chafodd ei guddio o'r golwg chwaith. Yn syml iawn, nid yw hyn ar yr agenda ar hyn o bryd, ac rwy'n dweud hynny gyda phob parch wrth y gŵr bonheddig.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Thank you.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Diolch i chi.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Llefarydd y Ceidwadwyr Cymreig, Natasha Asghar.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: The Welsh Conservatives' spokesperson, Natasha Asghar.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim:
Thank you so much, Presiding Officer. Counsel General, in April last year, the Supreme Court issued its landmark ruling in terms of sex, that 'man' and 'woman' refer strictly to biological sex only. Now, that ruling is crystal clear as far as I'm concerned, and anyone else with a shred of common sense will feel the same. Yet I fear certain Plaid Cymru politicians are still trying to get their heads around this. On the International Day of the Girl recently, the Deputy First Minister said, and I quote,

'On International Day of the Girl, we are reminded of the importance of ensuring people in Wales can manage their periods with dignity, confidence and pride'.

Now, Counsel General, I don't profess to be an expert in biology, but it is blindingly obvious that 'people' do not have periods; women and girls do, because to suggest otherwise would be absurd. Following the Supreme Court's ruling, the Equality and Human Rights Commission updated its code of practice, which came into force in August this year. It stressed that single-sex spaces should be just that—single sex. And only last week, NHS England announced it was issuing new guidance that patients should be assigned to single-sex wards based on their biological sex, which is a welcome move for me and my colleagues. So, Counsel General, how are you going to be ensuring the Welsh Government and other public bodies across Wales are following and implementing the law when it comes to protecting the rights of women and girls all across Wales?
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated:
Diolch yn fawr iawn i chi, Lywydd. Gwnsler Cyffredinol, ym mis Ebrill y llynedd, fe gyhoeddodd y Goruchaf Lys ei ddyfarniad nodedig o ran rhyw, sef bod 'dyn' a 'menyw' yn cyfeirio yn bendant at ryw biolegol yn unig. Nawr, mae'r dyfarniad hwnnw'n glir fel grisial yn fy marn i, ac fe fyddai unrhyw un arall â thamaid o synnwyr cyffredin yn teimlo'r un fath. Ond rwy'n ofni bod rhai gwleidyddion ym Mhlaid Cymru yn dal i ymdrechu i ddeall hyn. Ar Ddiwrnod Rhyngwladol y Ferch yn ddiweddar, fe ddywedodd y Dirprwy Brif Weinidog, ac rwy'n dyfynnu,

'Ar Ddiwrnod Rhyngwladol y Ferch, cawn ein hatgoffa o bwysigrwydd sicrhau bod pobl yng Nghymru yn gallu rheoli eu mislif gydag urddas, hyder a balchder'.

Nawr, Gwnsler Cyffredinol, nid wyf i'n honni bod yn arbenigwr mewn bioleg, ond mae hi'n gobl amlwg nad yw 'pobl' yn cael mislif; menywod a merched sy'n eu cael nhw, oherwydd fe fyddai awgrymu fel arall yn hurt. Yn dilyn dyfarniad y Goruchaf Lys, fe ddiweddarodd y Comisiwn Cydraddoldeb a Hawliau Dynol ei god ymarfer, ac fe ddaeth hwnnw i rym ym mis Awst eleni. Roedd yn pwysleisio y dylai llecynnau ar gyfer un rhyw olygu hynny'n union—un rhyw. A dim ond yr wythnos diwethaf, cyhoeddodd y GIG yn Lloegr ei fod yn cyhoeddi canllawiau newydd y dylai cleifion gael eu neilltuo i wardiau un rhyw yn seiliedig ar eu rhyw biolegol, sy'n gam i'w groesawu i'm cyd-Aelodau a minnau. Felly, Gwnsler Cyffredinol, sut ydych chi am sicrhau bod Llywodraeth Cymru a chyrff cyhoeddus eraill ledled Cymru yn dilyn ac yn gweithredu'r gyfraith o ran amddiffyn hawliau menywod a merched ledled Cymru?

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Again, that's an important issue and quite topical. We are going to observe the law, and the law is quite plain from the case to which she just referred. And it's a matter of drawing up our policies in accordance with that law. It's my duty to ensure that it does happen. The Government will, I am sure, adhere. I suppose the question is: when is it going to happen? Well, the sooner the better from my point of view, and if I have anything to do with it, which I will, I will certainly speak with colleagues about getting some proper, hard-and-fast policies, and so on, drawn up as soon as possible.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Unwaith eto, mae hwnnw'n fater pwysig ac yn gyfredol iawn. Fe fyddwn ni'n ufuddhau i'r gyfraith, ac mae'r gyfraith yn eithaf amlwg o'r achos y cyfeiriodd hi ato nawr. A mater yw hwnnw o lunio ein polisïau yn unol â'r gyfraith honno. Mae hi'n ddyletswydd arnaf i sicrhau bod hynny'n digwydd. Fe fydd y Llywodraeth, rwy'n siŵr, yn dal at hynny. Mae hi'n debyg mai'r cwestiwn yw: pryd y bydd hyn yn digwydd? Wel, cyntaf i gyd, gorau i gyd, yn fy marn i, ac os bydd gennyf i unrhyw beth i'w wneud â'r peth, yn sicr, fe fyddaf i'n siarad â chyd-Aelodau am lunio polisïau priodol, pendant, ac ati, cyn gynted â phosibl.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim:
Thank you very much for your response, Counsel General. I do appreciate that.

I want to turn to Plaid Cymru's dangerous plans for independence. Now, Plaid tried to downplay their ambition to rip Wales out of the United Kingdom during the election period in May. But, as soon as the party was in office, the mask slipped, and this is visible to everybody across Wales. The moving boxes hadn't been quite unpacked and already the First Minister was calling up his nationalist pals in Scotland and also Ireland. Next thing you know, the leaders of Sinn Féin, a party deeply tied up to terrorists in the IRA, and the Scottish National Party in Scotland are making their way to Cardiff for a separatist summit, drawing up plans to tear up the United Kingdom.

Now, frankly, I know—and many other people will agree—that independence will be disastrous for Wales. There's no two ways about it. Financially, it will ruin Wales, with an annual deficit of around about £21 billion. It will severely compromise our national security, and it will leave Welsh families financially worse off, costing every resident upwards of £7,000 extra in taxes every single year. Frankly, I believe that we are stronger and much better off in the United Kingdom. So, Counsel General, what legal advice have you provided to Ministers about their independence plans? And for the avoidance of doubt, can you confirm that this Welsh Government does not have the legal competence to unilaterally legislate for independence or call for a binding referendum? And do you agree with me that, given Plaid has no legal standing when it comes to independence, their efforts would be much better spent on tackling issues that they are responsible for, such as NHS waiting lists, educational outcomes and boosting the economy? There's your question.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated:
Diolch yn fawr iawn i chi am eich ymateb, Gwnsler Cyffredinol. Rwy'n gwerthfawrogi hynny, wir.

Fe hoffwn i droi at gynlluniau peryglus Plaid Cymru ar gyfer annibyniaeth. Nawr, fe geisiodd Plaid fychanu eu huchelgais i rwygo Cymru o'r Deyrnas Unedig yn ystod cyfnod yr etholiad ym mis Mai. Ond, cyn gynted ag yr oedd y blaid yn y swydd, fe lithrodd y mwgwd, ac mae hyn yn weladwy i bawb ledled Cymru. Prin yr oedden nhw wedi symud i mewn ac yn barod roedd y Prif Weinidog yn ffonio ei ffrindiau cenedlaetholgar yn yr Alban ac Iwerddon hefyd. Yn gyflym iawn, mae arweinwyr Sinn Féin, plaid sydd â chysylltiad cryf â therfysgwyr yn yr IRA, a Phlaid Genedlaethol yr Alban yn yr Alban yn gwneud eu ffordd i Gaerdydd ar gyfer uwchgynhadledd ymwahanwyr, gan lunio cynlluniau i rwygo'r Deyrnas Unedig yn ddarnau.

Nawr, i fod yn onest, rwy'n gwybod—ac fe fydd llawer o bobl eraill yn cytuno—y bydd annibyniaeth yn drychinebus i Gymru. Nid oes unrhyw amheuaeth am y peth. Yn ariannol, fe fyddai'n ysbeilio Cymru, gyda diffyg blynyddol o tua £21 biliwn. Fe fydd yn peryglu ein diogelwch cenedlaethol yn ddifrifol, ac fe fydd yn gadael teuluoedd Cymru yn dlotach yn ariannol, gan gostio mwy na £7,000 ychwanegol mewn trethi bob blwyddyn. Yn onest, rwy'n credu ein bod ni'n gryfach ac yn llawer gwell yn y Deyrnas Unedig. Felly, Gwnsler Cyffredinol, pa gyngor cyfreithiol a wnaethoch chi ei roi i Weinidogion am eu cynlluniau nhw ar gyfer annibyniaeth? Ac er mwyn osgoi amheuaeth, a wnewch chi gadarnhau nad oes gan y Llywodraeth hon y cymhwysedd cyfreithiol i ddeddfu dros annibyniaeth yn unochrog neu alw am refferendwm rhwymol? Ac a ydych chi'n cytuno â mi, o ystyried nad oes gan Blaid Cymru unrhyw allu cyfreithiol o ran annibyniaeth, y byddai hi'n llawer gwell iddi ymdrechu i fynd i'r afael â materion y mae hi'n gyfrifol amdanyn nhw, fel rhestrau aros y GIG, canlyniadau addysgol a rhoi hwb i'r economi? Dyna'r cwestiwn i chi.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Well, the Member's had her say. Little of that has any relevance to my job and, therefore, I say with respect that I'm not getting involved in the politics.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Wel, mae'r Aelod wedi cael dweud ei dweud. Ychydig iawn o hynna sy'n berthnasol i'm swydd ac, felly, rwy'n dweud gyda pharch nad wyf i am gymryd rhan yn y wleidyddiaeth.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Gangiau Grŵmio
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Grooming Gangs

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: 4. Pa gyngor cyfreithiol y mae’r Cwnsler Cyffredinol wedi’i roi i Lywodraeth Cymru ynghylch ei chyfrifoldebau cyfreithiol mewn perthynas â’r ymchwiliad annibynnol i gangiau grŵmio? OQ64725
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: 4. What legal advice has the Counsel General provided to the Welsh Government regarding its legal responsibilities in relation to the independent inquiry into grooming gangs? OQ64725

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: The independent inquiry into grooming gangs is, as the Member knows, a statutory inquiry established under the Inquiries Act 2005. The Welsh Government has a dedicated legal team working constructively with the inquiry, providing information, evidence and witness testimony as required, and engaging fully with its processes in relation to devolved responsibilities.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Fel y gŵyr yr Aelod, ymchwiliad statudol a sefydlwyd o dan Ddeddf Ymchwiliadau 2005 yw'r ymchwiliad annibynnol i gangiau grŵmio. Mae gan Lywodraeth Cymru dîm cyfreithiol pwrpasol sy'n gweithio yn adeiladol gyda'r ymchwiliad, sy'n darparu gwybodaeth, tystiolaeth a thystiolaeth gan dystion fel bod angen, ac ymgysylltu yn llawn â'i brosesau o ran cyfrifoldebau datganoledig.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Thank you. The inquiry has confirmed that it will examine matters involving devolved services in Wales. You started to clarify the legal obligations there placed on the Welsh Government to co-operate with the inquiry. Will this include provision of relevant documents and evidence, and will there be any legislative changes necessary following its findings?
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Diolch i chi. Mae'r ymchwiliad wedi cadarnhau y bydd yn archwilio materion sy'n cynnwys gwasanaethau sy'n ddatganoledig yng Nghymru. Fe wnaethoch chi ddechrau egluro'r rhwymedigaethau cyfreithiol a roddwyd ar Lywodraeth Cymru i gydweithredu â'r ymchwiliad. A fydd hyn yn cynnwys darparu dogfennau a thystiolaeth berthnasol, ac a fydd yna unrhyw newidiadau deddfwriaethol angenrheidiol yn dilyn ei ganfyddiadau?

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: We shall have to wait and see what the findings are, but, meantime, what I can assure the Member—it is an important point—is that we are fully engaged with the inquiry. The Welsh Government has applied for core participation status. The result of that application is awaited on a daily basis, but, even now, there is close liaison between officials of the Welsh Government and the grooming inquiry. There are separate strands to do with Wales and they will be fully addressed, and the whole gamut will be looked at very, very carefully. The list, as I've said, of core participants will be available shortly, but, as I say, we have a dedicated legal team working on it now, and they will continue apace, whatever happens. As for any legislation, we'll have to wait to see what the recommendations are and to evaluate them very carefully. It is a big subject and it's worthy of proper evaluation, and that is what the recommendations will get in due course.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Fe fydd yn rhaid i ni ddisgwyl i gael gweld beth fydd y canfyddiadau, ond, yn y cyfamser, yr hyn y gallaf i ei sicrhau i'r Aelod—mae hwn yn bwynt pwysig—yw ein bod ni'n ymgysylltu yn llawn â'r ymchwiliad. Mae Llywodraeth Cymru wedi gwneud cais am statws cyfranogiad creiddiol. Rydym ni'n disgwyl bob dydd am ganlyniad y cais hwnnw ond, hyd yn oed nawr, mae yna gysylltiad agos rhwng swyddogion Llywodraeth Cymru a'r ymchwiliad i grŵmio. Mae yna feysydd ar wahân yn ymwneud â Chymru ac fe fyddan nhw'n cael eu hystyried yn llawn, ac fe edrychir yn ofalus iawn, iawn ar bob un dim. Fe fydd y rhestr, fel dywedais i, o gyfranogwyr creiddiol ar gael cyn bo hir ond, fel dywedais i, mae gennym ni dîm cyfreithiol pwrpasol yn gweithio ar hyn nawr, ac fe fyddan nhw'n parhau ar gyflymder mawr, beth bynnag fo'n digwydd. Fel ar gyfer unrhyw ddeddfwriaeth, fe fydd rhaid i ni aros i gael gweld beth yw'r argymhellion a'u gwerthuso nhw'n ofalus iawn. Mae hwn yn bwnc enfawr ac mae'n deilwng o werthusiad priodol, a dyna'r hyn a roddir i'r argymhellion maes o law.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Datganoli Darlledu
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Devolution of Broadcasting

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: 5. Pa gyngor cyfreithiol y mae'r Cwnsler Cyffredinol wedi'i roi i Lywodraeth Cymru ynghylch datganoli darlledu i Gymru? OQ64746
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: 5. What legal advice has the Counsel General provided to the Welsh Government on the devolution of broadcasting to Wales? OQ64746

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Mae’r Llywodraeth hon wedi ymrwymo i weithio tuag at ddatganoli pwerau darlledu i Gymru, gan gynnwys pwerau i reoleiddio, i oruchwylio ac i sicrhau bod atebolrwydd dros ddarlledu a hefyd dros gyfathrebu yng Nghymru.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: This Government is committed to working towards the devolution of powers over broadcasting, including powers to regulate, supervise and ensure accountability for broadcasting and also communications in Wales.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Diolch yn fawr iawn i chi am yr ateb. Mi fuaswn i'n hoffi meddwl y gallem ni i gyd gytuno ei bod hi'n bwysig i gael sector darlledu cryf sy'n adlewyrchu ein gwlad a'n systemau ni. Mae'n hysbys i ni fod y rhan fwyaf o bobl yng Nghymru yn cael eu newyddion o du allan i Gymru, ac mae'n bwysig i ddemocratiaeth yma yng Nghymru fod pobl yn ymwybodol o beth sy'n digwydd yma. Ond mae hefyd yn bwysig i gael llais a safbwynt Cymreig ar faterion allanol. A ydych chi'n cytuno efo fi am yr angen i ddatganoli darlledu a'i fod yn gam pwysig wrth gryfhau bywyd sifig yng Nghymru?
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Thank you very much for that answer. I would like to think that we can all agree that it is important that we have a strong broadcasting sector that reflects our country and our systems. We know that most people in Wales get their news from sources outside Wales, and it's important for democracy here in Wales that people are aware of what happens here. But it's also important to hear a Welsh voice and perspective on external affairs. Do you agree with me about the need to devolve broadcasting and that this would be an important step towards strengthening civic life in Wales?

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim:
Mae'r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Ddiwylliant a Chwaraeon wedi gwneud datganiadau i'r Senedd hon am ei gwaith yn y maes yn casglu gwybodaeth a cheisio argymhellion ar y ffordd ymlaen. Yn wir, mae'r Gweinidog wedi ysgrifennu at yr Ysgrifennydd Gwladol dros Ddigidol, Diwylliant, Cyfryngau a Chwaraeon yn datgan yn glir ymrwymiad y Llywodraeth hon i fynd ar drywydd datganoli pwerau darlledu, ac yn gofyn am ddeialog bellach ar y pwnc. 

Ac mi fuaswn i'n ychwanegu drwy ddweud ei bod hi'n glir bod cenedl wybodus yn angenrheidiol i ddemocratiaeth a hefyd i drafodaeth gyhoeddus ar lefelau lleol, cenedlaethol a rhyngwladol er mwyn deall yr hyn sydd o gwmpas a'n rhan ni ynddo. Mae'r panel arbenigol ar ddarlledu, y Sefydliad Materion Cymreig a'r Comisiwn Annibynnol ar Ddyfodol Cyfansoddiadol Cymru i gyd wedi cydnabod yr angen am lais cryfach i Gymru ar faterion darlledu. I Llywodraeth Cymru, mae datganoli darlledu yn rhan hollbwysig o'r siwrnai honno.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated:
The Cabinet Minister for Culture and Sport has made statements to this Senedd on her work in this area in gathering evidence and seeking recommendations on the way forward. Indeed, the Minister has written to the Secretary of State for Digital, Culture, Media and Sport declaring clearly this Government's commitment to pursue the devolution of powers over broadcasting, and asking for further dialogue on the issue.

And I would add that it is clear that an informed nation is crucial for democracy and also for public debate at local, national and international levels in order to understand what is happening around us and our role in it. The expert panel on broadcasting, the Institute of Welsh Affairs and the Independent Commission on the Constitutional Future of Wales have all acknowledged the need for a stronger voice for Wales on broadcasting issues. For the Welsh Government, the devolution of broadcasting is a key part of that journey.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: I'm sure you just made a political statement about the strong broadcasting sector required to be devolved, but, okay, I'll forgive you on that one.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Rwy'n siŵr eich bod chi newydd wneud datganiad gwleidyddol ynglŷn â'r angen i'r sector darlledu cryf gael ei ddatganoli, ond, iawn, fe wnaf i faddau i chi am hynny.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Sorry, could you repeat that?
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Mae'n ddrwg gen i, a wnewch chi ddweud hynna eto?

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Yes, I thought you'd just made quite a political statement, because she asked you whether you agreed it should be devolved, and you said you did.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Iawn, roeddwn i'n credu eich bod chi newydd wneud datganiad gwleidyddol iawn, oherwydd fe ofynnodd hi i chi a oeddech chi'n cytuno y dylid ei ddatganoli, ac roeddech chi'n dweud eich bod chi.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: [Anghlywadwy.]—ateb y cwestiwn.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: [Inaudible.]—answer the question.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Okay, fair enough. It's obviously currently largely reserved to the UK Parliament, so the question is: how do you assess the implications of such a change with broadcasting to the overall existing constitutional settlement? So, how does that work by taking something out of the constitutional settlement?
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Iawn, digon teg. Mae hi'n amlwg mai mater a gedwir yn ôl i raddau helaeth i Senedd y DU yw hwn ar hyn o bryd, ac felly'r cwestiwn yw: sut ydych chi'n asesu goblygiadau newid o'r fath gyda darlledu i'r setliad cyfansoddiadol presennol yn gyffredinol? Felly, sut bydd hynny'n gweithio wrth gymryd rhywbeth allan o'r setliad cyfansoddiadol?

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Well, if there was to be devolution of broadcasting, then that would be quite a major undertaking. The finances would have to be delivered with it. It's quite a huge undertaking, but it's something that has been talked about for a long time by various commissions and so on, and it's something that this Government is pursuing. It won't happen overnight, but, if it does, what has to be ensured is that such a move would be totally independent of others controlling it, but also, crucially, that all the necessary finances would come this way with it, if you can understand the rather crude language. It would have to be properly financed, otherwise it simply would not work.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Wel, pe byddai datganoli darlledu yn digwydd, fe fyddai honno'n fenter sylweddol iawn. Fe fyddai hi'n rhaid cyflwyno'r cyllid gyda hynny. Mae hwnnw'n ymgymeriad enfawr, ond mae'n rhywbeth sydd wedi cael ei drafod ers amser maith gan wahanol gomisiynau ac ati, ac mae'n rhywbeth y mae'r Llywodraeth hon ar ei drywydd. Ni fydd yn digwydd dros nos ond, pe byddai'n digwydd, yr hyn y mae'n rhaid ei sicrhau yw y byddai symudiad o'r fath yn gwbl annibynnol ar reolaeth gan eraill ond hefyd, yn hollbwysig, y byddai'r cyllid angenrheidiol i gyd yn dod y ffordd yma gyda'r symudiad, os gallwch chi ddeall yr iaith eithaf amrwd. Fe fyddai'n rhaid i'r mater gael ei ariannu yn iawn, fel arall ni fyddai hynny'n gweithio.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Addysg Cydberthynas a Rhywioldeb
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Relationships and Sexuality Education

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: 6. Pa gyngor cyfreithiol y mae'r Cwnsler Cyffredinol wedi'i roi i Lywodraeth Cymru ynghylch a yw dileu hawl rhieni i dynnu eu plant yn ôl o addysg cydberthynas a rhywioldeb yn gyson â'r Confensiwn Ewropeaidd ar Hawliau Dynol? OQ64740
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: 6. What legal advice has the Counsel General provided to the Welsh Government regarding whether removing parents' right to withdraw their children from relationships and sexuality education is consistent with the European Convention on Human Rights? OQ64740

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: As the Member will know, there was a High Court judgment in 2022 that held that the provisions of the Curriculum and Assessment (Wales) Act 2021 in respect of relationships and sexuality education were compatible with the rights protected by the Human Rights Act 1998.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Fel y bydd yr Aelod yn gwybod, cafwyd dyfarniad yr Uchel Lys yn 2022 a ddyfarnodd fod darpariaethau Deddf Cwricwlwm ac Asesu (Cymru) 2021 mewn cysylltiad ag addysg cydberthynas a rhywioldeb yn gyson â'r hawliau a ddiogelir gan Ddeddf Hawliau Dynol 1998.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim:
Relationships and sexuality education, as you say, has been a compulsory element of the Curriculum for Wales since 2022. In its own words, the framework covers relationships, rights, equality and diversity. What parents may not be aware of, however, is that education is compulsory and in force in Wales from the age of three, including in funded nursery education. Moreover, unlike previous sex education arrangements, RSE is mandatory until 16, and parents do not have the general right to withdraw. Now, whatever our views on the ECHR may be, we are as lawmakers in the Senedd totally bound by the European convention on human rights. Article 2 of protocol No. 1 plainly states that

'the State shall respect the right of parents to ensure such education and teaching is in conformity with their own religious and philosophical convictions.'

So, quite simply, do parents in Wales actually still have the right to withdraw their children from RSE when it does not conform to their religious and philosophical convictions?
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated:
Mae addysg cydberthynas a rhywioldeb, fel y dywedwch chi, wedi bod yn elfen orfodol o Gwricwlwm Cymru ers 2022. Yn ei eiriau ei hun, mae'r fframwaith yn cwmpasu cydberthynas, hawliau, cydraddoldeb ac amrywiaeth. Yr hyn nad yw rhieni efallai yn ymwybodol ohono, fodd bynnag, yw bod addysg yn orfodol ac mewn grym yng Nghymru o dair oed, gan gynnwys mewn addysg feithrin a ariennir. Ar ben hynny, yn wahanol i drefniadau addysg rhyw blaenorol, mae addysg cydberthynas a rhywioldeb yn orfodol tan 16, ac nid oes gan rieni yr hawl gyffredinol i dynnu'n ôl. Nawr, beth bynnag yw ein barn ar Siarter Hawliau Dynol Ewrop, rydym fel deddfwyr yn y Senedd yn gwbl rwym gan y confensiwn Ewropeaidd ar hawliau dynol. Mae erthygl 2 o brotocol Rhif 1 yn nodi'n glir: 

'bydd y Wladwriaeth yn parchu hawl rhieni i sicrhau bod addysg a dysgeidiaeth o'r fath yn cydymffurfio â'u hargyhoeddiadau crefyddol ac athronyddol eu hunain.

Felly, yn syml, a oes gan rieni yng Nghymru yr hawl i dynnu eu plant yn ôl o addysg cydberthynas a rhywioldeb pan nad yw'n cydymffurfio â'u hargyhoeddiadau crefyddol ac athronyddol?

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim:
I don't believe there is a decided case on that as such, but there is on the question of withdrawing from sexuality education. That education is meant to be appropriate for the child's age and maturity, and, of course, it's open to the parents also to teach their children about such matters. But in terms of a challenge, the purpose of the mandatory RSE is to keep children safe, to promote respect for others, help them establish healthy relationships and protect them from harmful content and people online. The 2021 Act expressly requires that the children can only be provided with RSE that is appropriate for their children's age and their maturity. 

As for a challenge on human rights matters, in the Isherwood case, Mrs Justice Steyn said that

'the content of the Code and the Guidance is consistent with the requirement to take care to ensure that RSE teaching is conveyed in an objective critical and pluralistic manner, and does not breach the prohibition on indoctrination. There is nothing in the Code or the Guidance that authorises or positively approves teaching that advocates or promotes any particular identity or sexual lifestyle over another, or that encourages children to self-identify in a particular way.'

'In my judgment,'

she said,

'both the Code and the Guidance reflect the general spirit of the Convention as an instrument designed to maintain and promote the ideals and values of a modern liberal democracy, including the values of tolerance, respect and equality.'

And that reflects the current law as we stand.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated:
Dydw i ddim yn credu bod achos wedi'i benderfynu ar hynny fel y cyfryw, ond mae yna un ar y cwestiwn o dynnu'n ôl o addysg rhywioldeb. Mae'r addysg honno i fod yn briodol ar gyfer oedran ac aeddfedrwydd y plentyn, ac, wrth gwrs, mae'n agored i'r rhieni hefyd addysgu eu plant am faterion o'r fath. Ond o ran her, pwrpas addysg cydberthynas a rhywioldeb gorfodol yw cadw plant yn ddiogel, hyrwyddo parch at eraill, eu helpu i sefydlu perthnasoedd iach a'u hamddiffyn rhag cynnwys a phobl niweidiol ar-lein. Mae Deddf 2021 yn ei gwneud yn ofynnol yn benodol mai dim ond addysg cydberthynas a rhywioldeb sy'n briodol i oedran y plant a'u haeddfedrwydd y gellir ei darparu i'r plant.

O ran her ar faterion hawliau dynol, yn achos Isherwood, dywedodd Mrs Ustus Steyn

'mae cynnwys y Cod a'r Canllawiau yn gyson â'r gofyniad i sicrhau bod addysg cydberthynas a rhywioldeb yn cael ei chyflwyno mewn modd gwrthrychol, beirniadol a lluosog, ac nad yw'n torri'r gwaharddiad ar egwyddori. Nid oes unrhyw beth yn y Cod nac yn y Canllawiau sy'n awdurdodi neu'n cymeradwyo'n gadarnhaol addysgu sy'n argymell neu'n hyrwyddo unrhyw hunaniaeth benodol neu ffordd o fyw rhywiol dros un arall, neu sy'n annog plant i hunanddiffinio mewn ffordd benodol.'

'Yn fy marn i,'

dywedodd hi

mae'r Cod a'r Arweiniad ill dau yn adlewyrchu ysbryd cyffredinol y Confensiwn fel offeryn a ddyluniwyd i gynnal a hyrwyddo delfrydau a gwerthoedd democratiaeth ryddfrydol fodern, gan gynnwys gwerthoedd goddefgarwch, parch a chydraddoldeb."

Ac mae hynny'n adlewyrchu'r gyfraith bresennol fel yr ydym yn sefyll.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Polisïau Llywodraeth Cymru
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Welsh Government Policy

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: 7. Pa gyngor cyfreithiol y mae'r Cwnsler Cyffredinol wedi'i roi i Lywodraeth Cymru ynghylch cydnawsedd llunio polisïau Llywodraeth Cymru â Deddf Cydraddoldeb 2010? OQ64736
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: 7. What legal advice has the Counsel General provided to the Welsh Government on the compatibility of its policymaking with the Equality Act 2010? OQ64736

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: The Welsh Government is required to comply with equalities legislation within its policy areas. The Equality and Human Rights Commission acts as a regulator for ensuring compliance with equalities legislation across and beyond the public sector in Wales.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Mae'n ofynnol i Lywodraeth Cymru gydymffurfio â deddfwriaeth cydraddoldeb o fewn ei meysydd polisi. Mae'r Comisiwn Cydraddoldeb a Hawliau Dynol yn gweithredu fel rheoleiddiwr ar gyfer sicrhau cydymffurfiaeth â deddfwriaeth cydraddoldeb ar draws a thu hwnt i'r sector cyhoeddus yng Nghymru.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Thank you, Counsel General. The last Labour Government introduced a £5,000 grant for teacher training, but it was only available to student teachers from ethnic minorities, not on merit, but purely based on their skin colour. The current Plaid Cymru Government has carried on this scheme. Will the Counsel General agree to publish any legal advice given to the Welsh Government that they've received on this policy, and will he commit to ensuring that the Welsh Government makes any advice public, so that the people of Wales can see how their money has been spent on this piece of anti-white discrimination?
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Diolch, Gwnsler Cyffredinol. Cyflwynodd y Llywodraeth Lafur ddiwethaf grant o £5,000 ar gyfer hyfforddiant athrawon, ond dim ond i athrawon dan hyfforddiant o leiafrifoedd ethnig yr oedd ar gael, nid ar sail teilyngdod, ond ar sail lliw eu croen yn unig. Mae Llywodraeth bresennol Plaid Cymru wedi cynnal y cynllun hwn. A wnaiff y Cwnsler Cyffredinol gytuno i gyhoeddi unrhyw gyngor cyfreithiol a roddwyd i Lywodraeth Cymru ar y polisi hwn, ac a wnaiff ymrwymo i sicrhau bod Llywodraeth Cymru yn cyhoeddi unrhyw gyngor, fel y gall pobl Cymru weld sut cafodd eu harian ei wario ar y darn hwn o wahaniaethu gwrth-wyn?

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Well, as the Member knows, I cannot agree to publishing any legal advice, that is for sure, but on the general point she makes—again, an important point—the purpose of equalities law is to protect minority groups and those at risk of discrimination and also harassment. This aim fully reflects the Welsh Government's values. On 21 November 2025, the Welsh Government entered into a formal legal agreement with the Equality and Human Rights Commission, EHRC, under section 23 of the Equality Act 2006. This agreement presents a unique opportunity for the Welsh Government to strengthen the approach to assessing equality impacts, ensuring it is embedded consistently across the organisation. This will further build on and strengthen our approach to delivering policy and services for the people of Wales.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Wel, fel y gŵyr yr Aelod, ni allaf gytuno i gyhoeddi unrhyw gyngor cyfreithiol, mae hynny'n sicr, ond ar y pwynt cyffredinol y mae hi'n ei wneud—unwaith eto, pwynt pwysig—pwrpas cyfraith cydraddoldeb yw amddiffyn grwpiau lleiafrifol a'r rhai sydd mewn perygl o ddioddef gwahaniaethu a hefyd aflonyddu. Mae'r nod hwn yn adlewyrchu gwerthoedd Llywodraeth Cymru yn llawn. Ar 21 Tachwedd 2025, ymrwymodd Llywodraeth Cymru i gytundeb cyfreithiol ffurfiol gyda'r Comisiwn Cydraddoldeb a Hawliau Dynol, EHRC, o dan adran 23 o Ddeddf Cydraddoldeb 2006. Mae'r cytundeb hwn yn cyflwyno cyfle unigryw i Lywodraeth Cymru gryfhau'r dull o asesu effeithiau cydraddoldeb, gan sicrhau ei fod wedi'i ymgorffori'n gyson ar draws y sefydliad. Bydd hyn yn adeiladu ymhellach ar ein dull o ddarparu polisi a gwasanaethau i bobl Cymru ac yn ei gryfhau.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Canolfannau Data ar Raddfa Fawr
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Large-scale Data Centres

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: 8. Pa gyngor cyfreithiol y mae'r Cwnsler Cyffredinol wedi'i roi i Lywodraeth Cymru ynghylch pwerau Gweinidogion Cymru i alw ceisiadau cynllunio i mewn ar gyfer datblygiadau canolfannau data ar raddfa fawr, gan gynnwys y meini prawf statudol o dan y ddeddfwriaeth gynllunio berthnasol a'r dyletswyddau cyfreithiol sy'n gymwys pan geir cais o'r fath? OQ64745
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: 8. What legal advice has the Counsel General provided to the Welsh Government regarding Welsh Ministers’ powers to call in planning applications for large-scale data-centre developments, including the statutory criteria under the relevant planning legislation and the legal duties that apply when such a request is received? OQ64745

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: The law on this matter is quite clear. Call-in powers are set out in section 77 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990. Examples of proposals that may be called in are set out in 'Planning Policy Wales'. The Welsh Ministers may call in an application where they deem it appropriate.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Mae'r gyfraith ar y mater hwn yn eithaf clir. Mae pwerau galw i mewn wedi'u nodi yn adran 77 o Ddeddf Cynllunio Gwlad a Thref 1990. Mae enghreifftiau o gynigion y gellir eu galw i mewn wedi'u nodi yn 'Polisi Cynllunio Cymru'. Gall Gweinidogion Cymru alw cais i mewn lle maent yn ystyried ei fod yn briodol.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Given that several call-in requests for data centre schemes, including the one at the former Ferodo site near Caernarfon, are currently under consideration, what does the legal advice say about the statutory criteria under section 77 of the Town and Country Planning Act and the threshold of 'more than local importance', when issues such as grid capacity, energy demand or the absence of a specific national data centre policy are raised?
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: O ystyried bod nifer o geisiadau galw i mewn ar gyfer cynlluniau canolfannau data, gan gynnwys yr un ar hen safle Ferodo ger Caernarfon, yn cael eu hystyried ar hyn o bryd, beth mae'r cyngor cyfreithiol yn ei ddweud am y meini prawf statudol o dan adran 77 o'r Ddeddf Cynllunio Gwlad a Thref a'r trothwy o 'fwy na phwysigrwydd lleol', pan fo materion fel capasiti grid, galw am ynni neu absenoldeb polisi canolfan ddata genedlaethol benodol yn cael eu codi?

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim:
Well, I think I'd better be careful here because there is an application that has been received for a call-in on this particular issue. The planning system generally has a national local policy framework to determine applications for energy and other infrastructure projects. There is no specific legislative procedure for considering call-in requests. Powers are granted to the Welsh Ministers under section 77, as the Member knows, to call in where they see fit. And there are examples of the kind of criteria that would support a call-in. Under paragraph 1.35, 'Planning Policy Wales', these are some examples:

'proposals that:

'are in conflict with national planning policies;

'could have wide effects beyond their immediate locality;

'may give rise to substantial controversy beyond the immediate locality;

'are likely significantly to affect sites of scientific, nature conservation or historic interest or areas of landscape importance;

'raise issues of national security; or

'raise novel planning issues.'

Those are the criteria.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated:
Wel, rwy'n credu y byddai'n well i mi fod yn ofalus yma oherwydd mae cais wedi cael ei dderbyn ar gyfer galw i mewn ar y mater penodol hwn. Yn gyffredinol, mae gan y system gynllunio fframwaith polisi lleol cenedlaethol i bennu ceisiadau ar gyfer prosiectau ynni a seilwaith eraill. Nid oes unrhyw weithdrefn ddeddfwriaethol benodol ar gyfer ystyried ceisiadau galw i mewn. Rhoddir pwerau i Weinidogion Cymru o dan adran 77, fel y gŵyr yr Aelod, i alw i mewn lle maen nhw'n ei weld yn briodol. Ac mae yna enghreifftiau o'r math o feini prawf a fyddai'n cefnogi galw i mewn. O dan baragraff 1.35, 'Polisi Cynllunio Cymru', dyma rai enghreifftiau:

'yn achos cynigion:

'sy’n gwrthdaro â pholisïau cynllunio cenedlaethol;

'a allai gael effeithiau eang y tu hwnt i’w hardal leol;

'a allai achosi dadlau mawr y tu hwnt i’r ardal leol;

'sy’n debygol o effeithio’n sylweddol ar safleoedd o ddiddordeb gwyddonol, cadwraeth natur neu ddiddordeb hanesyddol neu ardaloedd sy’n bwysig oherwydd eu tirwedd;

'sy’n codi materion sy’n gysylltiedig â diogelwch cenedlaethol; neu

'sy’n codi materion cynllunio newydd.'

Dyna'r meini prawf.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Sbectolau Clyfar
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Smartglasses

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: 9. Pa gyngor cyfreithiol y mae'r Cwnsler Cyffredinol wedi'i roi i Lywodraeth Cymru ynghylch defnyddio sbectolau clyfar a alluogir gan ddeallusrwydd artiffisial mewn adeiladau cyhoeddus megis llyfrgelloedd a phyllau nofio, yn sgil y gwaharddiadau sydd mewn grym mewn llysoedd a thribiwnlysoedd? OQ64749
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: 9. What legal advice has the Counsel General provided to the Welsh Government regarding the use of AI-enabled smart glasses in public buildings such as libraries and swimming pools given the ban in courts and tribunals? OQ64749

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: New technologies, including smartglasses, can offer benefits and present challenges. Individual operators of public buildings are responsible for developing policies that take account of privacy and of safeguarding considerations that are appropriate to the use of each building and the needs of stakeholders, customers and the staff.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Gall technolegau newydd, gan gynnwys sbectolau clyfar gynnig manteision a chyflwyno heriau. Mae gweithredwyr unigol adeiladau cyhoeddus yn gyfrifol am ddatblygu polisïau sy'n ystyried preifatrwydd ac ystyriaethau diogelu sy'n briodol i'r defnydd o bob adeilad ac anghenion rhanddeiliaid, cwsmeriaid a'r staff.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Courts and tribunals have restricted these devices, and, in fact, I've just heard the Cabinet Office banned them last week. I think we've learned that news from this Chamber travels rather fast. In fact, the Member's glasses opposite have been discussed in buildings 200 miles away. All these institutions have concluded that people in those spaces are entitled to know whether they're being recorded. The same question applies to a library, a leisure centre, a GP surgery or even a school, and these are places where people have no reason to expect they are being filmed. I'd be grateful to know whether the Welsh Government considers existing data protection law sufficient for this, or whether it intends to give further guidance to public bodies in Wales.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Mae llysoedd a thribiwnlysoedd wedi cyfyngu'r dyfeisiau hyn, ac, mewn gwirionedd, rydw i newydd glywed bod Swyddfa'r Cabinet wedi eu gwahardd yr wythnos diwethaf. Rwy'n credu ein bod wedi dysgu bod newyddion o'r Siambr hon yn teithio yn eithaf cyflym. Mewn gwirionedd, mae sbectol yr Aelod gyferbyn wedi cael ei thrafod mewn adeiladau 200 milltir i ffwrdd. Mae'r holl sefydliadau hyn wedi dod i'r casgliad bod gan bobl yn y mannau hynny hawl i wybod a ydyn nhw'n cael eu recordio. Mae'r un cwestiwn yn berthnasol i lyfrgell, canolfan hamdden, meddygfa neu hyd yn oed ysgol, ac mae'r rhain yn llefydd lle nad oes gan bobl unrhyw reswm i ddisgwyl eu bod yn cael eu ffilmio. Byddwn yn ddiolchgar i wybod a yw Llywodraeth Cymru o'r farn bod y gyfraith diogelu data bresennol yn ddigonol ar gyfer hyn, neu a yw'n bwriadu rhoi canllawiau pellach i gyrff cyhoeddus yng Nghymru.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: A tailored approach is needed, given the wide-ranging use and activities undertaken in public buildings. What is suitable in one setting may not be in another, and operators are best placed to make sensible policies based on their own responsibilities as data controllers and according to their individual risk appetite. Swimming pools are likely to be an example where particular care and greater restrictions may well be appropriate. The approach taken in courts and tribunals will be informed by the long-standing prohibition on recordings being made unless special permission has been given. So, local authorities and other public bodies are responsible for their own compliance with data protection requirements and also managing their own security risks. Following our own review of Welsh Government policy, we will consider if there is any guidance we can issue to public bodies.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Mae angen dull wedi'i deilwra, o ystyried y defnydd a'r gweithgareddau eang a geir mewn adeiladau cyhoeddus. Efallai na fydd yr hyn sy'n addas mewn un lleoliad yn addas mewn lleoliad arall, ac mae gweithredwyr yn y sefyllfa orau i wneud polisïau synhwyrol yn seiliedig ar eu cyfrifoldebau eu hunain fel rheolwyr data ac yn ôl eu parodrwydd i dderbyn risg unigol. Mae pyllau nofio yn debygol o fod yn enghraifft lle gall gofal penodol a mwy o gyfyngiadau fod yn briodol. Bydd y dull a gymerir mewn llysoedd a thribiwnlysoedd yn cael ei lywio gan y gwaharddiad hirsefydlog ar recordiadau oni bai bod caniatâd arbennig wedi'i roi. Felly, mae awdurdodau lleol a chyrff cyhoeddus eraill yn gyfrifol am eu cydymffurfiaeth eu hunain â gofynion diogelu data a hefyd am reoli eu risgiau diogelwch eu hunain. Yn dilyn ein hadolygiad ein hunain o bolisi Llywodraeth Cymru, byddwn yn ystyried a oes unrhyw ganllawiau y gallwn eu rhoi i gyrff cyhoeddus.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Gangiau Grŵmio
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Grooming Gangs

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: 10. Pa gyngor cyfreithiol y mae'r Cwnsler Cyffredinol wedi'i roi i Lywodraeth Cymru ynghylch ei rôl yn yr ymchwiliad cenedlaethol i gangiau grŵmio? OQ64737
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: 10. What legal advice has the Counsel General provided to the Welsh Government regarding its role within the national inquiry into grooming gangs? OQ64737

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: The independent inquiry into grooming gangs is a statutory inquiry, established under the Inquiries Act 2005. The Welsh Government is working constructively with the inquiry and stands ready to provide information, evidence and witness testimony as required, while engaging fully with the inquiry's processes on matters within devolved responsibilities.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Mae'r ymchwiliad annibynnol i gangiau grŵmio yn ymchwiliad statudol, a sefydlwyd o dan Ddeddf Ymchwiliadau 2005. Mae Llywodraeth Cymru yn gweithio'n adeiladol gyda'r ymchwiliad ac yn barod i ddarparu gwybodaeth, tystiolaeth a thystiolaeth tystion yn ôl yr angen, gan ymgysylltu'n llawn â phrosesau'r ymchwiliad ar faterion o fewn cyfrifoldebau datganoledig.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Thank you, Counsel General. Young white women and children in this country were groomed, raped and trafficked, often by groups of mainly Pakistani men over decades. The worst injustice this country has seen, in my opinion. Wales needs its own inquiry. There are strong suspicions that it happened in Swansea, in my constituency, along with many other places in Wales. Section 29 of the Inquiries Act lets Welsh Ministers hold an inquiry into anything they have functions over. So, my question is simple, Counsel General: does the Welsh Government have the legal power to hold its own inquiry into how devolved services in Wales failed these children and young women—'yes' or 'no'?
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Diolch, Gwnsler Cyffredinol. Cafodd menywod ifanc a phlant gwyn yn y wlad hon eu grŵmio, eu treisio a'u masnachu, yn aml gan grwpiau o ddynion Pacistanaidd yn bennaf dros ddegawdau. Yr anghyfiawnder gwaethaf y mae'r wlad hon wedi'i weld, yn fy marn i. Mae angen ei hymchwiliad ei hun ar Gymru. Mae amheuon cryf ei fod wedi digwydd yn Abertawe, yn fy etholaeth i, ynghyd â llawer o lefydd eraill yng Nghymru. Mae adran 29 o'r Ddeddf Ymchwiliadau yn caniatáu i Weinidogion Cymru gynnal ymchwiliad i unrhyw beth y mae ganddynt swyddogaethau drosto. Felly, mae fy nghwestiwn yn syml, Gwnsler Cyffredinol: a oes gan Lywodraeth Cymru y pŵer cyfreithiol i gynnal ei hymchwiliad ei hun i sut y gwnaeth y gwasanaethau datganoledig yng Nghymru siomi'r plant a'r menywod ifanc hyn—'oes' neu 'nac oes'?

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Yes, but I would suggest that it's prudent now to await the decisions and recommendations of the present inquiry. What may come of that, I know not. It may be that a separate inquiry may be considered. I know not. I do not know. None of us knows what's going to come out of this inquiry. What I do know is that we have a specialist team that are working very, very closely with the inquiry team, and Welsh issues are being raised properly, as they should be. We've applied for core participation status, and the outcome of that application is expected very, very shortly. I can assure the Member—and it's an important point again—I can assure the Member that we are making every possible effort to ensure that the problems that occurred in Wales are properly evaluated, properly researched and are part of the inquiry. For the future, who knows? Let's see what the recommendations will be. But I can assure her that we do not take the issue lightly.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Oes, ond byddwn yn awgrymu ei bod yn ddoeth nawr aros am benderfyniadau ac argymhellion yr ymchwiliad presennol. Beth allai ddod o hynny, wn i ddim. Efallai y bydd ymchwiliad ar wahân yn cael ei ystyried. Wn i ddim. Dwi ddim yn gwybod. Nid oes unrhyw un ohonom yn gwybod beth sy'n mynd i ddod allan o'r ymchwiliad hwn. Yr hyn rwy'n ei wybod yw bod gennym dîm arbenigol sy'n gweithio'n agos iawn, iawn gyda'r tîm ymchwilio, ac mae materion Cymreig yn cael eu codi'n briodol, fel y dylent fod. Rydym wedi gwneud cais am statws cyfranogiad craidd, ac mae disgwyl canlyniad y cais hwnnw yn fuan iawn. Gallaf sicrhau'r Aelod—ac mae'n bwynt pwysig eto—gallaf sicrhau'r Aelod ein bod yn gwneud pob ymdrech bosibl i sicrhau bod y problemau a ddigwyddodd yng Nghymru yn cael eu gwerthuso'n briodol, eu hymchwilio'n briodol a'u bod yn rhan o'r ymchwiliad. Ar gyfer y dyfodol, pwy a ŵyr? Gadewch i ni weld beth fydd yr argymhellion. Ond gallaf ei sicrhau nad ydym yn cymryd y mater yn ysgafn.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Yn olaf, cwestiwn 11. John Clark.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Finally, question 11. John Clark.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Sefydlu Awdurdodaeth Gyfreithiol Benodol neu ar Wahân
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Establishing a Distinct or Separate Legal Jurisdiction

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: 11. Pa gyngor cyfreithiol y mae'r Cwnsler Cyffredinol wedi'i roi i Lywodraeth Cymru ynghylch goblygiadau cyfreithiol sefydlu awdurdodaeth gyfreithiol benodol neu ar wahân i Gymru? OQ64744
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: 11. What legal advice has the Counsel General provided to the Welsh Government on the legal implications of establishing a distinct or separate legal jurisdiction for Wales? OQ64744

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: The first thing I should say is that a distinct or separate legal jurisdictions are two separate things. We already have a distinct jurisdiction in Wales in as much as Welsh laws are used in Welsh courts, Welsh judges and so on. A lot of Welsh law has been created within this building. So, to that end, we have a distinct jurisdiction already. Turning to the separate legal jurisdiction, it's an entirely different matter altogether. The Welsh Government supports the formal establishment of a Welsh legal jurisdiction to provide greater legal clarity for practitioners and citizens as Welsh law continues to develop. This would not in practice require a separate judiciary or court system, nor the creation of a separate legal profession, qualifications or regulatory requirements.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Y peth cyntaf y dylwn ei ddweud yw bod awdurdodaethau cyfreithiol gwahanol neu ar wahân yn ddau beth ar wahân. Mae gennym eisoes awdurdodaeth wahanol yng Nghymru i'r graddau y defnyddir cyfreithiau Cymru mewn llysoedd Cymru, barnwyr Cymraeg ac ati. Mae llawer o gyfraith Cymru wedi'i chreu yn yr adeilad hwn. Felly, i'r perwyl hwnnw, mae gennym awdurdodaeth wahanol eisoes. Gan droi at yr awdurdodaeth gyfreithiol ar wahân, mae'n fater hollol wahanol. Mae Llywodraeth Cymru yn cefnogi sefydlu awdurdodaeth gyfreithiol Cymru yn ffurfiol i ddarparu mwy o eglurder cyfreithiol i ymarferwyr a dinasyddion wrth i gyfraith Cymru barhau i ddatblygu. Ni fyddai hyn, yn ymarferol, yn gofyn am system farnwrol neu lys ar wahân, na chreu proffesiwn cyfreithiol, cymwysterau na gofynion rheoleiddio ar wahân.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: What legal advice has the Counsel General provided on the practical implications of moving from the existing distinct body of Welsh law to a fully separate jurisdiction, specifically for the single England and Wales legal profession, cross-border practices, access to justice, and legal certainty for businesses operating on both sides of the border?
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Pa gyngor cyfreithiol y mae'r Cwnsler Cyffredinol wedi'i roi ar oblygiadau ymarferol symud o'r corff gwahanol presennol o gyfraith Cymru i awdurdodaeth gwbl ar wahân, yn benodol ar gyfer proffesiwn cyfreithiol unigol Cymru a Lloegr, arferion trawsffiniol, mynediad at gyfiawnder, a sicrwydd cyfreithiol i fusnesau sy'n gweithredu ar ddwy ochr y ffin?

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Well, I've just answered that question; I've answered that question once. What is proposed would have no effect. What is happening on the ground has no effect on legal practitioners. If I give him an example, when I was at the bar, I was in a court in Manchester on a Monday, Wolverhampton on a Tuesday, Wrexham or Caernarfon on a Thursday and Friday. The regulations applying to children's law were completely different in Wales. But I'm not a genius and I managed it, and I'm sure our colleagues in England will continue to manage it. But the point is that as the corpus juris of Wales is growing, as the separate legal steps being taken within Wales are growing—and will grow, clearly, as we legislate—there will come a time for further consideration, but not a consideration of in any way changing the nature of the legal profession. The legal profession can rest assured—as can, importantly, the people of Wales—that people will be able to come and represent them whether they are in Wales or whether they practice across the border. Provided they're up to speed on Welsh regulation and Welsh law, there will be no bar to them practising.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Wel, rydw i newydd ateb y cwestiwn yna; rydw i wedi ateb y cwestiwn yna unwaith. Ni fyddai'r hyn sy'n cael ei gynnig yn cael unrhyw effaith. Nid yw'r hyn sy'n digwydd ar lawr gwlad yn cael unrhyw effaith ar ymarferwyr cyfreithiol. Os rhoddaf enghraifft iddo, pan oeddwn yn y bar, roeddwn i mewn llys ym Manceinion ar ddydd Llun, Wolverhampton ar ddydd Mawrth, Wrecsam neu Gaernarfon ar ddydd Iau a dydd Gwener. Roedd y rheoliadau sy'n berthnasol i gyfraith plant yn hollol wahanol yng Nghymru. Ond dydw i ddim yn athrylith ac fe wnes i ddod i ben â hynny, ac rwy'n siŵr y bydd ein cydweithwyr yn Lloegr yn parhau i ddod i ben â hynny. Ond y pwynt yw, wrth i corpus juris Cymru dyfu, wrth i'r camau cyfreithiol ar wahân sy'n cael eu cymryd yng Nghymru dyfu—a byddant yn tyfu, yn amlwg, wrth i ni ddeddfu—bydd amser i ystyried ymhellach, ond nid ystyried newid natur y proffesiwn cyfreithiol. Gall y proffesiwn cyfreithiol fod yn sicr—fel y gall, yn bwysig, bobl Cymru—y bydd pobl yn gallu dod i'w cynrychioli p'un a ydynt yng Nghymru neu'n ymarfer dros y ffin. Ar yr amod eu bod â'r wybodaeth ddiweddaraf am reoleiddio yng Nghymru a chyfraith Cymru, ni fydd unrhyw rwystr iddyn nhw rhag ymarfer.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Diolch, Gwnsler Cyffredinol.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Thank you, Counsel General.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Symudwn yn nawr at y datganiad a chyhoeddiad busnes. Galwaf ar y Trefnydd, Heledd Fychan.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: We'll now move to the business statement and announcement. I call on the Trefnydd, Heledd Fychan.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Member_job_title_English: Trefnydd, Chief Whip and Cabinet Minister for Culture and Sport
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Member_job_title_Welsh: Trefnydd, Prif Chwip a Gweinidog Cabinet dros Ddiwylliant a Chwaraeon
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Diolch, Lywydd. Nid oes unrhyw newidiadau i fusnes yr wythnos hon. Mae busnes drafft y tair wythnos nesaf wedi'i nodi yn y datganiad busnes sydd ar gael fel arfer i'r Aelodau yn electronig.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Thank you, Llywydd. There are no changes to this week's business, and draft Plenary business for the next three weeks is shown on the business statement, which is available to Members electronically, as usual.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Could I have a statement from the Trefnydd and the Welsh Government on what efforts are being taken to address rough-sleeping and homelessness in Wales? As we're coming into the winter time, it's becoming very concerning about how many people are sleeping out in horrendous conditions right now, and I'd be grateful if the Government could come forward on what we can do, and, hopefully, we can find consensus around the Chamber to address this, so we don't see more lives lost by rough-sleeping this winter.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: A gaf i ddatganiad gan y Trefnydd a Llywodraeth Cymru ar ba ymdrechion sy'n cael eu cymryd i fynd i'r afael â chysgu allan a digartrefedd yng Nghymru? Wrth i ni ddod i mewn i'r gaeaf, mae llawer yn pryderu ynghylch y nifer o bobl sy'n cysgu allan mewn amodau erchyll ar hyn o bryd, a byddwn yn ddiolchgar pe bai'r Llywodraeth yn gallu rhoi gwybodaeth am yr hyn y gallwn ei wneud, a gobeithio, gallwn ddod o hyd i gonsensws o amgylch y Siambr i fynd i'r afael â hyn, fel nad ydym yn gweld mwy o fywydau yn cael eu colli yn sgil cysgu allan y gaeaf hwn.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Diolch am godi mater fydd o bwys i nifer fawr ohonom ni, os nad pob Aelod yma. Mi fyddaf i'n sicr o wneud y Gweinidog Cabinet yn ymwneud eich bod chi wedi codi hyn, sef Siân Gwenllian, a gweld pa ddiweddariadau sydd ar gael i'r holl Aelodau.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Thank you for raising a matter that will be of great importance to a number of us, if not every Member here. I will certainly make the Cabinet Minister aware that you have raised this issue, namely Siân Gwenllian, and see what updates are available for all Members.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: We have a shortage of housing available for rent. Houses that were previously privately rented have been converted into Airbnb properties. This housing shortage is made worse by the growth of Airbnb properties. These Airbnb properties take business away from guest houses and hotels; they create parking problems. It's not just a problem of tourist areas; it affects areas with older terraced housing, as well as properties at the seaside. There is control over houses in multiple occupation concentrations to stop areas becoming HMO areas. We need the same for Airbnb. I'm asking for a Government statement on what action they intend to take to control the growth of Airbnb, or are they going to let it just grow and grow?
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Mae gennym brinder tai ar gael i'w rhentu. Mae tai a oedd yn cael eu rhentu yn breifat o'r blaen wedi cael eu troi'n eiddo Airbnb. Mae'r prinder tai hwn yn cael ei waethygu gan dwf eiddo Airbnb. Mae'r eiddo Airbnb hyn yn dwyn busnes gwestai; maen nhw'n creu problemau parcio. Nid problem mewn ardaloedd twristaidd yn unig ydyw; mae'n effeithio ar ardaloedd gyda thai teras hŷn, yn ogystal ag eiddo ar lan y môr. Mae rheolaeth dros grynodiadau o dai amlfeddiannaeth i atal ardaloedd rhag dod yn ardaloedd tai amlfeddiannaeth. Mae angen yr un peth arnom ar gyfer Airbnb. Rwy'n gofyn am ddatganiad gan y Llywodraeth ar ba gamau maen nhw'n bwriadu eu cymryd i reoli twf Airbnb, neu a ydyn nhw'n mynd i adael iddo dyfu a thyfu?

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Diolch. Dwi'n siŵr y bydd yr Aelod yn ymwybodol bod yna waith wedi'i wneud rhwng eich plaid chi a'm plaid i drwy'r cytundeb cydweithio ar y mater hwn, a nifer o fesurau wedi'u rhoi mewn lle sydd o fewn gallu awdurdodau lleol i fod yn medru eu gweithredu. Yn sicr, mae hwn yn fater byw iawn; mae o'n berthnasol hefyd wrth gwrs i'r adroddiad sydd wedi'i gyflwyno i'r Llywodraeth flaenorol, ond rydym ni'n mynd i fod yn gweithredu'r argymhellion hynny, o ran cymunedau Cymraeg yn benodol, ond dwi'n cydnabod mae hi yn broblem, a dyna pam mae yna gydweithio wedi bod i edrych am ddatrysiadau yn y maes hwn, a byddwn ni'n parhau i edrych ar hynny.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Thank you. I'm sure the Member will be aware that work was done between your party and my party through the co-operation agreement on this issue, and a number of measures were put in place that are within the gift of local authorities to implement. Certainly, this is a very live issue; it's also pertinent to the report presented to the previous Government, but we will be implementing those recommendations, in terms of, specifically, Welsh-speaking communities, but I do acknowledge that it is a problem, and that's why there has been co-operation to look for solutions in this area, and we will continue to look at that.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim:
Trefnydd, I'd like to request a statement from the Deputy First Minister and Cabinet Minister for Social Justice and Equality on the Welsh Government's support for people with learning disabilities across Wales. As I mentioned to the First Minister earlier, last week I met with Mencap Cymru to discuss their 'I'm In' campaign, which highlights the importance of GP learning disability registers as a gateway to accessing annual health checks. Of course, it's important that we have access to the relevant data to ensure that people with learning disabilities are accessing these vital health checks.

Another issue raised with me was the increasing difficulties that people with learning disabilities face when trying to access and use cash within their local communities. Now, in my view, organisations that receive public funding should be able to accept cash payments from the public, and access to cash continues to be an important way of promoting independence and inclusion for many people with learning disabilities. Therefore, I'd be grateful if we could have a statement from the Welsh Government on its position on support for people with learning disabilities, including measures to improve access to annual health checks and its approach to ensuring continued access to cash for those who actually rely on it.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated:
Drefnydd, hoffwn ofyn am ddatganiad gan y Dirprwy Brif Weinidog a'r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Gyfiawnder Cymdeithasol a Chydraddoldeb ar gefnogaeth Llywodraeth Cymru i bobl ag anableddau dysgu ledled Cymru. Fel y soniais wrth y Prif Weinidog yn gynharach, yr wythnos diwethaf cyfarfûm â Mencap Cymru i drafod eu hymgyrch 'Rydw i Mewn', sy'n tynnu sylw at bwysigrwydd cofrestrau anabledd dysgu meddygon teulu fel porth i gael mynediad at wiriadau iechyd blynyddol. Wrth gwrs, mae'n bwysig bod gennym fynediad at y data perthnasol i sicrhau bod pobl ag anableddau dysgu yn cael mynediad at y gwiriadau iechyd hanfodol hyn.

Mater arall a godwyd gyda mi oedd yr anawsterau cynyddol y mae pobl ag anableddau dysgu yn eu hwynebu wrth geisio cael gafael ar arian parod a'i ddefnyddio yn eu cymunedau lleol. Nawr, yn fy marn i, dylai sefydliadau sy'n derbyn cyllid cyhoeddus allu derbyn taliadau arian parod gan y cyhoedd, ac mae mynediad at arian parod yn parhau i fod yn ffordd bwysig o hyrwyddo annibyniaeth a chynhwysiant i lawer o bobl ag anableddau dysgu. Felly, byddwn yn ddiolchgar pe gallwn gael datganiad gan Lywodraeth Cymru ar ei safbwynt ar gymorth i bobl ag anableddau dysgu, gan gynnwys mesurau i wella mynediad at wiriadau iechyd blynyddol a'i dull o ran sicrhau mynediad parhaus at arian parod i'r rhai sy'n dibynnu arno mewn gwirionedd.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Diolch i'r Aelod am y cwestiynau hynny a'r ceisiadau hynny. Mi fyddwch chi wedi clywed ymateb y Prif Weinidog yn flaenorol, ond hefyd mi fyddwch chi yn ymwybodol o ymrwymiad y Dirprwy Brif Weinidog a Gweinidog Cabinet dros Gyfiawnder Cymdeithasol a Chydraddoldeb o ran y meysydd hyn. Mi oedd hi, yn y Senedd ddiwethaf, yn gadeirydd grwpiau trawsbleidiol oedd yn edrych ar nifer o'r pethau rydych chi wedi'u codi. Mi wnaf i sicrhau ei bod hi yn ymwybodol eich bod chi wedi codi'r materion pellach hyn heddiw a sicrhau bod yna ddiweddariad i chi o ran y gwaith sy'n mynd rhagddo.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: I thank the Member for those questions and those requests. You will have heard the response of the First Minister earlier on today, but also you will be aware of the commitment of the Deputy First Minister and Cabinet Minister for Social Justice and Equality in terms of these areas. She, in the previous Senedd, was the chair of cross-party groups that did look at a number of the issues that you've raised. I will ensure that she is aware that you have raised these further issues today and ensure that there is an update given to you on the work that is under way.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: I'd like to ask for a statement from the Cabinet Minister for Rural Resilience and Sustainability on the state of dog breeding in Wales and whether the Welsh Government intends to review the current regulatory framework. The RSPCA has raised concerns that dog breeding continues on a considerable scale in Wales and that existing legislation may no longer be fit for purpose. There have also been calls for a review of current laws, a centralised microchipping database, consideration of a national scoring system for breeders and whether a national representative body could provide greater support to responsible breeders. Given the importance of protecting animal welfare, while ensuring that responsible breeders have the support and the clarity they need, can the Welsh Government outline whether it will review the current regulatory framework to ensure it remains effective and fit for purpose and whether it will consider combining and streamlining the regulation into a single piece of legislation?
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Hoffwn ofyn am ddatganiad gan y Gweinidog Cabinet dros Wydnwch Gwledig a Chynaliadwyedd ar gyflwr bridio cŵn yng Nghymru ac a yw Llywodraeth Cymru yn bwriadu adolygu'r fframwaith rheoleiddio presennol. Mae'r RSPCA wedi codi pryderon bod bridio cŵn yn parhau ar raddfa sylweddol yng Nghymru ac efallai na fydd y ddeddfwriaeth bresennol bellach yn addas i'r diben. Bu galwadau hefyd am adolygiad o'r cyfreithiau cyfredol, cronfa ddata microsglodion canolog, ystyried system sgorio genedlaethol ar gyfer bridwyr ac a allai corff cynrychioliadol cenedlaethol ddarparu mwy o gefnogaeth i fridwyr cyfrifol. O ystyried pwysigrwydd diogelu lles anifeiliaid, gan sicrhau bod bridwyr cyfrifol yn cael y gefnogaeth a'r eglurder sydd eu hangen arnynt, a all Llywodraeth Cymru amlinellu a fydd yn adolygu'r fframwaith rheoleiddio presennol i sicrhau ei fod yn parhau i fod yn effeithiol ac yn addas i'r diben ac a fydd yn ystyried cyfuno a symleiddio'r rheoliad i greu un darn o ddeddfwriaeth?

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Diolch i'r Aelod am godi'r mater hwnnw. Mi fyddwn i'n gofyn i chi, gan fod yna nifer o gwestiynau i'r Gweinidog yn yr hyn wnaethoch chi'n ei godi efo fi, ysgrifennu at y Gweinidog fel eich bod chi'n gallu cael ymateb llawn ar y pwyntiau penodol hynny. Ond yr hyn fedraf i ddweud ydy bod lles anifeiliaid yn rhywbeth sydd o bwys mawr i'r Llywodraeth hon, a byddwn ni yn gweithredu yn unol â hynny.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: I thank the Member for raising that issue. I would ask you, because there were a number of questions to the Minister in what you raised with me, to write to the Minister so that you can get a full response on those specific points. But what I can tell you is that animal welfare is something that's very important to this Government, and we will act in accordance with that.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim:
Prynhawn da, Drefnydd. I'd like two statements, please. Last week I met coracle fishermen from west Wales. They were promoting their very, very unique craft. I don't know if you know—they are very small boats, they carry them on their back, and they only fish at night between Monday and Friday. However, the period of them being able to fish has been massively reduced by Natural Resources Wales. So, could I just ask what the Government is going to be doing in order to protect this important Welsh tradition?

The other statement is with regard to job opportunities for physiotherapy graduates. We're in this terrible place where we've trained physiotherapists and we can't give them jobs, and yet we are crying out for people to have the service of a physiotherapist. So, please, could you tell us what the Government's intentions are to ensure that physiotherapists get the jobs that they need to be able to deliver the services to the people of Wales? Diolch yn fawr iawn, Lywydd.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated:
Prynhawn da, Drefnydd. Hoffwn gael dau ddatganiad, os gwelwch yn dda. Yr wythnos diwethaf cwrddais â physgotwyr cwrwgl o'r gorllewin. Roedden nhw'n hyrwyddo eu crefft unigryw iawn, iawn. Nid wyf yn gwybod os ydych chi'n gwybod—cychod bach iawn ydyn nhw, maen nhw'n eu cario ar eu cefn, a dim ond yn pysgota gyda'r nos rhwng dydd Llun a dydd Gwener. Fodd bynnag, mae'r cyfnod y maen nhw'n gallu pysgota wedi cael ei leihau'n sylweddol gan Cyfoeth Naturiol Cymru. Felly, a gaf i ofyn beth mae'r Llywodraeth yn mynd i'w wneud er mwyn diogelu'r traddodiad Cymreig pwysig hwn?

Mae'r datganiad arall yn ymwneud â chyfleoedd gwaith i raddedigion ffisiotherapi. Rydyn ni yn y sefyllfa ofnadwy hon lle rydyn ni wedi hyfforddi ffisiotherapyddion ac ni allwn roi swyddi iddyn nhw, ac eto rydyn ni'n gweiddi er mwyn i bobl gael gwasanaeth ffisiotherapydd. Felly, os gwelwch yn dda, a wnewch chi ddweud wrthym beth yw bwriadau'r Llywodraeth o ran sicrhau bod ffisiotherapyddion yn cael y swyddi sydd eu hangen arnynt i allu darparu'r gwasanaethau i bobl Cymru? Diolch yn fawr iawn, Lywydd.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim:
Diolch yn fawr iawn i'r Aelod am godi'r ddau fater yna. O ran y cwrwgl, yn sicr, mae hwnna yn rhywbeth sy'n rhan o'n traddodiad ni fel cenedl, onid ydy? Rhywbeth unigryw yw, ac, yn sicr, byddwn i yn awgrymu eich bod chi yn ysgrifennu yn benodol at y Gweinidog, ond, o ran yr ochr treftadaeth dwi'n gyfrifol amdano fo hefyd, mi wnaf i weld beth ydy'r hyn sydd yn berthnasol o ran fy mhortffolio i.

O ran yr ail beth hefyd, efo ffisiotherapi, yn amlwg rydym ni yn cydnabod pa mor bryderus ydy'r sefyllfa hon. Byddwch chi yn gweld bod yna gyhoeddiad ddoe o ran rhai o'r swyddi o ran nyrsys yn benodol. Ond rydym ni yn cydnabod bod yna rai eraill lle mae'r sefyllfa wedi bod yn ofnadwy o bryderus iddyn nhw, a'r diffyg cynllunio hwnnw yn dod drosodd yn gryf. Mi ydym ni'n ymrwymo i helpu graddedigion i gael cyflogaeth a chadw eu sgiliau o fewn y gwasanaeth iechyd yma yng Nghymru. Maen nhw'n sgiliau sydd dirfawr eu hangen. Felly, dwi'n cydnabod yr hyn yr ydych chi'n ei godi ac mi fyddaf yn sicr yn gwneud y Gweinidog Cabinet dros Iechyd a Gofal yn ymwybodol eich bod chi wedi codi'r pwyntiau hyn y prynhawn yma.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated:
I thank the Member for raising those two issues. In terms of the coracle, certainly, that is something that is part of our tradition as a nation, isn't it? It's unique, and, certainly, I would suggest that you do write specifically to the Minister, but, in terms of the heritage aspect, which I'm responsible for, I'll see what is relevant in terms of my portfolio.

In terms of the second point, with regard to physiotherapy, clearly we do acknowledge how concerning the situation is. You will see that there was an announcement made yesterday in terms of some of the posts with regard to nurses specifically. But we do acknowledge that there are other roles where the situation has been very concerning, and the lack of planning comes over clearly in that regard. We are committed to helping graduates to gain employment and to keep their skills within the health service here in Wales. They are skills that are very much needed. So, I acknowledge and recognise what you've raised and I will certainly be making the Cabinet Minister for Health and Care aware of the points that you've raised this afternoon.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim:
I ask the Welsh Government for a statement on capital investment into north Wales's civic and sporting infrastructure, specifically regarding the urgent need for a 50m Olympic-sized swimming pool. Currently, Wales has just two 50m facilities—one in Cardiff and one in Swansea; and from Holyhead right along the A55 corridor there is not a single one. Our young, talented athletes and their families are forced to make multi-hour round trips across the border into England several times a week just to train on equal terms with their peers. With 80 per cent of Welsh public pools over 20 years old—and I can tell you that for a fact because I worked in one many years ago—and Betsi Cadwaladr under immense strain, a modern aquatics hub would deliver a vital preventative health dividend and teach life-saving skills.

Will the Trefnydd arrange for the Welsh Government, alongside Sport Wales, Swim Wales and local authorities, to commission a formal feasibility study to finally deliver regional equity for north Wales and commit the Welsh Government to putting an end to years of regional underinvestment, get this project on the table and deliver the fair funding and preventative healthcare infrastructure that the people of north Wales deserve? Diolch.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated:
Rwy'n gofyn i Lywodraeth Cymru am ddatganiad ar fuddsoddiad cyfalaf yn seilwaith dinesig a chwaraeon y gogledd, yn benodol ynglŷn â'r angen brys am bwll nofio maint Olympaidd 50m. Ar hyn o bryd, dim ond dau gyfleuster 50m sydd gan Gymru—un yng Nghaerdydd ac un yn Abertawe; ac o Gaergybi ar hyd coridor yr A55 ni cheir un o gwbl. Mae ein hathletwyr ifanc, talentog a'u teuluoedd yn cael eu gorfodi i deithio yn ôl a blaen dros y ffin â Lloegr am oriau lawer sawl gwaith yr wythnos i hyfforddi ar delerau cyfartal â'u cyfoedion. Gyda 80 y cant o byllau cyhoeddus Cymru dros 20 mlwydd oed—a gallaf ddweud hynny wrthych chi oherwydd bûm yn gweithio mewn un flynyddoedd lawer yn ôl—a Betsi Cadwaladr o dan straen enfawr, byddai canolfan ddŵr fodern yn darparu difidend iechyd ataliol hanfodol ac yn dysgu sgiliau achub bywydau.

A wnaiff y Trefnydd drefnu i Lywodraeth Cymru, ochr yn ochr â Chwaraeon Cymru, Nofio Cymru ac awdurdodau lleol, gomisiynu astudiaeth ddichonoldeb ffurfiol i gyflawni tegwch rhanbarthol ar gyfer y gogledd o'r diwedd ac ymrwymo Llywodraeth Cymru i roi terfyn ar flynyddoedd o danfuddsoddi rhanbarthol, cael y prosiect hwn ar y bwrdd a darparu'r cyllid teg a'r seilwaith gofal iechyd ataliol y mae pobl y gogledd yn ei haeddu? Diolch.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim:
Wel, yr hyn oedd yr Aelod yn ei godi oedd am ddatganiad; fel y Gweinidog efo'r cyfrifoldeb am hynny, dwi eisoes wedi gwneud datganiadau sydd yn sôn am y gwaith dwi wedi'i gomisiynu ynghylch edrych ar yr holl strwythurau o ran chwaraeon, gan gynnwys pyllau nofio, i ddeall beth ydy'r sefyllfa ledled Cymru, beth ydy maint y buddsoddiad sydd ei angen a lle mae'r bylchau yn bodoli, gan gynnwys, wrth gwrs, ar gyfer pyllau nofio o faint y byddai'n gallu cynnal cystadlaethau, neu ar gyfer y rhai sydd yn mynd ati'n broffesiynol. Mi welsom ni nifer fawr o athletwyr yn cynrychioli Cymru yng Ngemau'r Gymanwlad yng Nglasgow, er enghraifft, ac ennill nifer o fedalau.

Dwi'n deall ac yn cydnabod y materion y mae'r Aelod wedi eu codi, ond mae'n rhaid i fi gael gwneud y gwaith trylwyr hwnnw ar y funud o wneud y gwerthuso hwnnw i ddeall beth ydy'r angen ledled Cymru—ym mhob rhan o Gymru, gan gynnwys y gogledd—i sicrhau bod gennym ni gynllun cyfalaf hirdymor ar gyfer buddsoddi mewn cyfleusterau o'r fath.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated:
Well, the issue the Member raised was for a statement; as the Minister with responsibility for that, I have already made statements that talk about the work that I have already commissioned in relation to looking at the whole range of structures in sport, including swimming pools, in order to understand what the situation across Wales is, the scale of investment that's required and where the gaps exist, including, of course, swimming pools of an adequate size to stage competitions or for those who want to train at a professional level. We saw a number of athletes representing Wales in the Commonwealth Games in Glasgow, for example, and they won a number of medals.

I do understand and recognise the issues that the Member raised, but I do have to do that thorough work first in carrying out that evaluation in order to understand what the needs are across Wales—in all parts of Wales, including north Wales—in order to ensure that we have a long-term capital programme for investing in facilities of that kind.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim:
Trefnydd, 4 November marks a year since the publication of 'Our Bravery Brought Justice'. I know that you will remember how united the whole Chamber was in shock at the failings exposed in that report. So, can I ask that a statement is brought forward by the Cabinet Minister for education, as I'm sure you would agree with me that we all have a duty to make sure—and we owe it to the young people affected to ensure—that all 27 of those recommendations are fully implemented?

Can I note as well the wildfire summit on Thursday? This is of great importance, particularly to those of us who were affected by wildfires in the summer. So, can I ask that the First Minister brings forward a statement after recess to update us on the outcomes and findings of the summit?
